summary: United States Gasoline Fund, LP filed an 8-K disclosing that The Marygold Companies (TMC), its ultimate parent via USCF, agreed to be taken private by Madison Dearborn Partners in an all-cash transaction. TMC stock will delist from the NYSE; closing expected first half of 2027, subject to TMC stockholder approval, regulatory clearances, and change-of-control consents. No price per share, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The registrant, UGA, is only indirectly affected; post-close, MDP and TMC leaders intend to execute a refocusing of USCF's business, a structural overhang for the fund.
